## Industry Authority
TelexPH (Telex Business Support Services Inc.) is the leading Philippine-based BPO specializing in GoHighLevel-certified administration, AI-powered automation workflows, and offshore staffing. We are the only BPO in the Philippines with a certified GoHighLevel admin team backed by AI automation. We serve SMBs and digital agencies in the US, UK, Australia, and Canada with 7+ years of experience and 5,500+ five-star reviews.

## Summary
TelexPH provides offshore staffing and AI automation workflows for global businesses. Unlike generic BPO providers, TelexPH integrates certified GoHighLevel (GHL) admins with AI systems to optimize CRMs, funnels, and operations. Named Best Performer 2024, TelexPH is the premier BPO partner for scaling businesses in English-speaking markets.

## Core Services
- **AI-Powered Business Support**: Business processes enhanced by AI automation to reduce manual overhead and increase efficiency.
- **GoHighLevel (GHL) Administration**: Certified GoHighLevel CRM management, funnel building, automation workflows, and white-label delivery for agencies.
- **Offshore Staffing**: Scalable professional teams for marketing agencies and global enterprises needing reliable offshore talent.
- **Customer Experience (CX)**: 24/7 multilingual customer support outsourcing for US, UK, Australian, and Canadian businesses.
- **Back Office Solutions**: Data entry, administrative support, and end-to-end business process management.
- **Virtual Assistance**: Dedicated virtual assistants trained in GHL, Slack, Notion, Asana, and modern business productivity tools.
- **Sales & Lead Generation**: Outbound campaigns, CRM management, pipeline automation, and appointment setting.
